title: {{tier}} recording partnership agreement
notice: WORKING DRAFT - LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED - NOT ISSUED FOR SIGNATURE

sections.title: 1. Parties and authority
sections.text: Label contracting party: {{label_legal_name}}. Legal capacity, registration number where applicable and registered address: {{label_details}}. Authorized representative: {{label_signatory}}. Artist contracting party: {{artist_legal_name}}, professionally known as {{artist_name}}, with address and capacity: {{artist_details}}. Each signatory's authority must be verified before issuance. Artanrecords is the label brand, not a substitute for identifying the legal contracting party.

sections.title: 2. Covered recordings and services
sections.text: This draft concerns only the recordings identified in Schedule A: {{recordings}}. Agreed services and deliverables: {{services}}. No unrelated release, future work or service is included unless expressly identified in the final agreement. Release dates, platform delivery and third-party acceptance remain subject to the agreed release plan and applicable service requirements; no placement, stream count or income is guaranteed.

sections.title: 3. Term, territory and rights
sections.text: Effective date: {{effective_date}}. Contract term and renewal provisions: {{term}}. Territory: {{territory}}. Rights granted, exclusivity, permissions, sublicensing and post-termination treatment: {{rights}}. No transfer of master ownership or publishing rights is inferred from the partnership name or revenue allocation. Any grant must be expressly stated in the reviewed final rights schedule.

sections.title: 4. Recording-income allocation
sections.text: Proposed {{tier}} allocation: Artist {{artist_share}}%; Artanrecords {{label_share}}%. These are the canonical default recording allocations, commercial terms version {{commercial_version}}, and become contractual only in the final executed version. The basis is Eligible Net Master Receipts: actual recording receipts for the covered recordings, after reported adjustments and only deductions specifically allowed by the final agreement. Permitted deductions, exclusions, currency treatment and recoupment, if any: {{deductions}}. Do not apply this allocation to gross DSP estimates, publishing, merchandise, Store sales or Studio subscriptions.

sections.title: 5. Project Artist Pool and collaborators
sections.text: The Artist's {{artist_share}}% allocation forms the Project Artist Pool before any separately executed contributor allocations. Collaborator credit alone creates no revenue entitlement. Any contributor participation requires a separate agreement identifying the contributor, covered work, percentage, effective dates and revenue basis; it must not silently reduce Artanrecords' {{label_share}}% share. Applicable contributor schedule, if any: {{contributors}}.

sections.title: 6. Reporting, payment and tax
sections.text: Reporting frequency, statement delivery, payment timing, currency, withdrawal minimum where applicable, reserves, refunds, verification requirements and any approved fees: {{reporting_payment}}. No dashboard estimate is a verified payable balance. Tax responsibility and any legally required withholding: {{tax}}. This draft does not establish an internal wallet or authorize bank transfers, charges or withdrawals.

sections.title: 7. Materials, approvals and responsibilities
sections.text: The final agreement must identify delivery specifications, rights clearances, credits, artwork permissions, artist approvals and each party's responsibilities: {{responsibilities}}. Content declarations and any warranties or liability allocation require legal review. No broader warranty, indemnity or ownership declaration is inferred by the software.

sections.title: 8. Changes, ending the relationship and disputes
sections.text: Amendments require a new fixed version and renewed acceptance where appropriate; the signed historical version must remain unchanged. Termination rights, notice, cure periods, takedown handling and continuing reporting obligations: {{termination}}. Governing law, jurisdiction and dispute procedure: {{governing_law}}. These provisions must be completed by an authorized legal reviewer before the agreement can be issued.

sections.title: 9. Studio access and activation
sections.text: Included software access, its start and end dates, and service scope: {{studio_access}}. A tier request, selection, draft preview or proposed agreement does not activate a partnership. Activation requires the fixed reviewed agreement, authenticated signatures of both parties, explicit signing consent, server-recorded evidence and final authorized confirmation. Activation must reference that exact agreement version and cannot create financial payout eligibility by itself.

sections.title: 10. Electronic signing and records
sections.text: The final signing procedure must present the exact document and schedules, allow review and questions, record affirmative consent, bind each authenticated signer to the document digest, and preserve the signed record and event history. Agreed signature assurance, verification method and records policy: {{signing_policy}}. A typed name, uploaded image or preview alone is not proof that this agreement has been executed.
